## History

Frank West attended college for two years before his failing health forced him to return home and take up farming. When his son [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) was fourteen years old, Frank committed suicide by hanging himself from a lamp hook in his parlor on his wedding anniversary.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)_
